title: VisioLink
summary: A low-cost virtual reality solution that uses a smartphone as a VR display and a laptop webcam with MediaPipe/OpenCV-based computer vision to track head and hand motion, streaming control signals over WebSockets. The SDV-family packages (sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, copulas) are listed in requirements.txt but never referenced in the code or README, unrelated to the project's VR tracking purpose.
evidence: requirements.txt: sdv==1.18.0, ctgan==0.10.2, rdt==1.14.0, sdmetrics==0.18.0, copulas==0.12.1; no matching code usage
needs: Dependencies listed but no call sites found; likely leftover/unused from a template or unrelated feature.
